newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria forex reserves rise to $575 mln in August.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria forex reserves rise to $575 mln in August.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank's (BNB) foreign exchange reserves rose to $574.700 million on August 31 from $522.484 million a month before, the BNB said on Friday.
"The BNB's foreign exchange reserves stood at $574.700 million on August 31," the central bank said in a statement.
BNB FX RESERVES, AUGUST JULY AUGUST '95
Central bank officials were not available to comment on the figures.

Bulgaria, hammered by an economic crisis, pledged to seek to increase its forex reserves by 50 percent by the end of the year under a funding agreement with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) signed in July.

This month the IMF postponed a needed second tranche of some $115 million of its funding programme for Bulgaria due to the country's delay in meeting structural reform targets and closing down loss-making state firms.
